projects.description: Compresses 26B AI reasoning models by 52% to run entirely on ordinary 6GB laptop GPUs at 45 words/second with zero cloud servers.
lines: # MAPLE
IMG0
### Compresses 26B AI reasoning models by 52% to run entirely on ordinary 6GB laptop GPUs at 45 words/second with zero cloud servers.
Large language models usually require massive cloud clusters. MAPLE removes
dormant neural pathways from Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, shrinking
Gemma 4 26B from 9.92 GB down to 4.75 GB. The compressed model runs 100%
inside consumer laptop GPU memory at 45.4 tokens per second while preserving
mathematical and coding intelligence. Reached 65+ GitHub stars and 300+
downloads within 24 hours of release.
Built with Python · PyTorch · GGUF · MoE · CUDA
[Visit](https://github.com/AmSach/maple)
